images.name: 余烬·错翼
images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE original fantasy BOW weapon concept illustration for the Arcane Armory mod, second Heteromorphic series. Portrait image, one complete full-length bow, front/very slight three-quarter view so limb thickness is visible. Entire bow and its thin luminous straight bowstring visible with generous margins. Bow upright, grip in center, bowstring along right, dark charcoal empty studio background. Leftward outward curved limbs, tips at upper-right and lower-right; preserve a practical straight narrow central palm grip, 14% of bow length of clear hand space, arrow clearance toward string. Clearly a FUNCTIONAL BOW, not a sword, staff or crossbow.
Style: polished original game weapon concept art, radical distinct silhouette with simple thick bevelled geometric solids, smooth colored magical-light planes, brighter edges and darker saturated faces. NO metal filigree, NO gritty mineral/crystal textures, NO gem clusters, NO wood, NO six-pointed star. Broad solid forms and purposeful negative spaces; nothing flimsy or wire-thin apart from the string. Restrained local luminous bloom, keep structure legible. Sparse matching geometric particles immediately near limbs, not obscuring grip or silhouette. No text, watermark, logo, characters, hands, scenery, extra bows or inset panels.
Design: radical asymmetric SCARLET / crimson bow with restrained rose highlights. A massive upper limb shaped like a broad single angular swept cleaver blade with one long stepped negative-space slot. The lower limb is visually lighter, a compact sequence of THREE sturdy offset rectangular stair-step plates curving to the lower nock, securely joined by a thick continuous spine. Upper and lower tips still reach similar distance from center for the string; asymmetry is in silhouette and mass, not a tiny bottom half. Central grip: straight slim solid-light palm bar seated between a squared upper collar and a single hooked triangular lower knuckle-guard projecting LEFT away from the string, not two matching loops. Wide outer cutting-looking surfaces, no hexagonal chains. A few red rectangular ember chips at the upper slot. Strong deliberate imbalance, cohesive brutal architecture, model-friendly coarse geometry.
